BlackRock and Ondo Launch Tokenized ETF Portfolio Strategies for Non-U.S. Investors

According to WSJ, BlackRock and Ondo Finance have launched Ondo Intelligent Portfolios, bringing BlackRock’s customized ETF portfolio strategies onchain as transferable tokens for the first time. Available to eligible investors outside the U.S., the initial lineup includes three strategies: High Income (BLKHIon), Diversified Growth (BLKDIGon) and High Growth (BLKGRWon). Investors can access ETF portfolio exposure through a single transferable token using major wallets and DeFi applications. — link

Stablecoin Infrastructure Firm HIFI Raises $37 Million in Series A Led by Left Lane Capital

HIFI has raised $37 million in a Series A funding round led by Left Lane Capital. The company plans to use the capital to expand its tokenized capital markets infrastructure and product suite.

In July, HIFI participated alongside BlackRock, Goldman Sachs and Nasdaq in a tokenized securities transaction within DTCC’s DTC production environment. The company also partnered with Visa earlier this month. — link

U.S. Initial Jobless Claims Came in at 197,000 Last Week, Below Market Expectations of 201,000

U.S. initial jobless claims for the week ending September 19 totaled 197,000, coming in below the projected 201,000, while the previous week's figure was revised from 196,000 to 198,000. — link

IBM Links Digital Asset Platform to Swift Ledger for Tokenized Deposits

IBM said its digital asset management and custody platform has connected to a permissioned network that includes Swift’s blockchain-based shared ledger.

A new ISO 20022 message adapter allows financial institutions to send tokenized deposit transaction instructions through existing payment formats and workflows. IBM also launched an on-premises trial version for deployment on IBM Z and LinuxONE systems without relying on public cloud infrastructure. — link

Nexo Report: 67% of Affluent Investors Own Crypto, Only 4.7% Deeply Integrated

Nexo’s Future of Digital Wealth 2026 report surveyed 1,000 affluent investors across three countries. About 67% own crypto, but only 4.7% are deeply integrated users. Nearly 20% expect crypto to be their top wealth driver over the next decade. Operational infrastructure emerged as the key barrier to full integration. — link

US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See $347M Net Inflows; Ether ETFs Add $105M

U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $347 million in net inflows on Sept. 23, according to SoSoValue, with BlackRock’s IBIT leading the group at $166 million. Spot Ether ETFs also posted $105 million in net inflows, led by BlackRock’s ETHA with about $50.8 million. Combined inflows across the two major U.S. spot crypto ETF categories reached roughly $452 million for the day. — link
